$comment: 语法大厅 G05（V0.9 P1b）。锚点：报幕——「舞台上有……」。全部内容原创。
title: There be 句型
ketNote: KET 阅读与写作里描述场景的标配句型；There has 是中式高频错。be 的形态规则同 L1。

sections.essence: There be 是报幕员：先说「有」，再亮出主角——某地有某物。
sections.why: 中文的「有」一个字干两份活：「我有一支长笛」（拥有）和「桌上有一支长笛」（存在）。英语把这两份活分给两个词：某人拥有什么用 have；某个地方存在什么用 There be。中国孩子最常写 There has a book——把两个「有」缝在了一起。还要注意：这个 there 不是「那里」的意思，它只是个站在句首的报幕员，没有实义；句子真正的主角是 be 后面的名词，be 的单复数也跟着主角走：There is a piano. / There are two drums.
sections.metaphorStory: 每场演出开幕，报幕员先上台：「舞台上有一架钢琴，有两位鼓手，还有一整排小提琴。」报幕员自己不是节目，他的任务只是把「有什么」引出来。There be 就是这位报幕员：There is a piano on the stage. 主角是钢琴，不是 there——所以 be 的形态看主角：一架钢琴用 is，两位鼓手用 are。如果报幕员一口气报两样东西，他看离自己最近的那样定 is 还是 are：There is a piano and two drums.（先报的是一架钢琴，用 is）——这叫就近原则，报幕员的老规矩。

cards.rule: There is + 单数 / 不可数
cards.detail: 主角是一个，或者是空气队（不可数），报幕用 is。
cards.example: There is a flute in the box. / There is some milk.

cards.detail: 主角是两个以上，报幕用 are。
cards.example: There are two drums on the stage.

cards.rule: 报两样东西看最近的（就近原则）
cards.detail: be 的形态跟第一个被报出的主角走。
cards.example: There is a piano and two drums. / There are two drums and a piano.

cards.rule: 提问和否定都在 be 上做
cards.detail: Is/Are there...? 回答 Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.；否定 There isn't / aren't，或 There is no...
cards.example: — Are there any eggs? — Yes, there are.

cards.rule: 拥有用 have，存在用 There be
cards.detail: 「我有」是 have；「某地有」是 There be——两个「有」别串线。
cards.example: I have a flute. / There is a flute on the desk.

basic.en: There is a piano in the music room.
basic.cn: 音乐教室里有一架钢琴。

basic.en: There are two drums on the stage.
There is some water in the bottle.
There are many students in the hall.
There is a park near my home.

mid.en: Is there a music room in your school?
mid.cn: 你们学校有音乐教室吗？

mid.en: There aren't any clouds in the sky.
How many pandas are there in the zoo?
mid.cn: 动物园里有多少只熊猫？

mid.en: There is no bread at home. Let's buy some.
mid.cn: 家里没面包了，去买点吧。

mid.en: There will be a concert tomorrow evening.
mid.cn: 明晚有一场音乐会。（报幕员也能报明天）

trap.en: There is a pen and two books in the bag.
trap.cn: 包里有一支笔和两本书。
trap.note: 就近原则：先报的是 a pen，所以用 is，别被后面的 two books 带跑。

trap.en: There are two books and a pen in the bag.
trap.cn: 包里有两本书和一支笔。
trap.note: 换个顺序先报 two books，就得用 are——同一个包，两种报法。

trap.en: There is some rice in the bowl.
trap.note: rice 是空气队（不可数），永远配 is——联动 G01。

trap.en: My school has a big library.
trap.cn: 我们学校有个大图书馆。
trap.note: 学校「拥有」图书馆，用 has 也对；说 There is a big library in my school 同样对——两条路都通，别混成 There has。

trap.en: There is something wrong with my violin.
trap.note: something 一族当单数看，配 is。

trap.en: — Is there any juice? — Yes, there is.
trap.note: 简答重复 there is/are，不说 Yes, it is。

redBlack.bad: It has a park near my home.
redBlack.good: There is a park near my home.
redBlack.why: 听的人会找「它」是谁、是什么东西拥有公园——存在要用报幕员 There is。

redBlack.bad: Have a big tree in the garden.
redBlack.good: There is a big tree in the garden.
redBlack.why: 没有主语的 have 让人不知道谁有树——「某地有」必须请报幕员开场。

redBlack.bad: There has a book on the desk.
redBlack.good: There is a book on the desk.
redBlack.why: 两个「有」缝在一起了——There be 里只能用 be，不能用 has。

redBlack.bad: There have many people in the square.
redBlack.good: There are many people in the square.
redBlack.why: 同样的病：报幕员只带 be，不带 have。

redBlack.bad: There are a bird in the tree.
redBlack.good: There is a bird in the tree.
redBlack.why: 主角是一只鸟，单数——报幕用 is。

redBlack.bad: There is two windows in the room.
redBlack.good: There are two windows in the room.
redBlack.why: 两扇窗，复数——报幕用 are。

redBlack.bad: There is many milk in the fridge.
redBlack.good: There is much milk in the fridge. / There is a lot of milk.
redBlack.why: milk 是空气队：报幕用 is 没错，但「很多」要用 much / a lot of——联动 G01。

redBlack.bad: — Is there a piano? — Yes, it is.
redBlack.good: — Is there a piano? — Yes, there is.
redBlack.why: There be 的简答要重复 there——Yes, there is。

redBlack.bad: There are no a cloud in the sky.
redBlack.good: There are no clouds in the sky. / There isn't a cloud in the sky.
redBlack.why: no 和 a 不能叠用：no 后面直接跟名词。
is 和 have 挤在一个句子里——报幕员只需要一个 be。

redBlack.bad: There are a pen and two books in the bag.
redBlack.good: There is a pen and two books in the bag.
redBlack.why: 就近原则说先报的 a pen 配 is——但母语者也常顺口说 are，不挡意思，KET 很少刁难。

redBlack.bad: There're many birds in the tree.
redBlack.good: There are many birds in the tree.
redBlack.why: There're 这个缩写口语里有、考试里别写——写全 There are 最稳。

contrast.cn: 「有」一个字管两件事：我有笔 / 桌上有笔
contrast.en: I have a pen. / There is a pen on the desk.
contrast.diff: 中文一个「有」通吃；英语分两条路——拥有 have，存在 There be。

contrast.cn: 桌上有一本书。（「有」不变形）
contrast.en: There is a book. / There are two books.
contrast.diff: 中文的「有」永远一个样；英语的报幕员看主角人数换 is/are。

contrast.cn: 那里有一只猫。（「那里」是真地点）
contrast.en: There is a cat there.（第一个 there 是报幕员，第二个才是「那里」）
contrast.diff: 句首的 there 没有实义，只是开场站位——别翻译成「那里」。

contrast.en: There is someone at the door.
contrast.diff: 英语的报幕句通常要交代地点；someone 一族当单数配 is。

contrast.cn: 学校有图书馆。（拥有、存在分不出来）
contrast.en: My school has a library. = There is a library in my school.
contrast.diff: 英语两条路都能走，但零件不能混装——There has 是缝合怪。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 谁有→have，哪有→There be；be 看主角，两样看最近
steps: 先分清：是「某人拥有」还是「某地存在」？拥有 have，存在 There be。
There be 里永远不出现 have——There has 是缝合怪，见到就改。
找 be 后面的主角：一个或不可数 → is；两个以上 → are。
一口气报两样 → 看离报幕员最近的那样（就近原则）。
提问把 be 提到 there 前面；简答重复 there is / there are。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语里说『桌上有一本书』，要先请一位报幕员出场，他叫 There is——先喊『有！』再说有什么。咱们玩报幕游戏：你当报幕员，把咱家客厅报一遍——『客厅里有一台电视、两个沙发、三盆花』，每报一样，你告诉我该用 is 还是 are。」不用懂英语，只要陪她数：报的东西是一个还是好几个。她说错时问一句：「你报的主角是几个呀？」另外注意听她有没有说出「There has」——那是把中文的『有』塞进去了，提醒她报幕员只说 is / are。
questions: 「我有一支笔」和「桌上有一支笔」——英语里是同一个「有」吗？
报幕员 There is 和 There are，什么时候用哪个？
「包里有一支笔和两本书」——报幕员看哪一样决定 is 还是 are？

sections.echo: 句首的 there 本来真是「那里」：古英语的人说「那里站着一棵树」，手还指着方向。说了几百年，「那里」的方向感被磨光了，只剩一个站在句首的空壳，专门给报幕用——语言学家管这叫「语法化」：常用的词被磨掉肉，剩下骨架当语法零件。a 和 the 是这样磨出来的（G02），there 也是。词和楼梯一样，最常踩的地方最先磨平。

stages.name: 认一认 · is 还是 are

questions.q: There ___ a piano in the hall.
questions.explain: 一架钢琴，单数——is。

questions.q: There ___ two drums on the stage.
questions.explain: 两面鼓，复数——are。

questions.q: There ___ some water in the glass.
questions.explain: water 空气队（不可数）——is。

questions.q: There ___ many students in the hall.
questions.explain: many students 复数——are。

questions.q: There ___ a cat under the chair.
questions.explain: 一只猫——is。

questions.q: There ___ five violins in the box.
questions.explain: 五把小提琴——are。

questions.q: There ___ some bread on the plate.
questions.explain: bread 空气队——is。

questions.q: There ___ a lot of people in the park.
questions.explain: people 是复数「人们」——are。

questions.q: There ___ some milk in the fridge.
questions.explain: milk 空气队——is。

questions.q: There ___ three eggs in the bowl.
questions.explain: 三个鸡蛋——are。

questions.q: There ___ a bird and two cats in the garden.
questions.explain: 就近原则：先报的是 a bird——is。

questions.q: There ___ two cats and a bird in the garden.
questions.explain: 就近原则：先报的是 two cats——are。

questions.q: There ___ some rice in the bag.
questions.explain: rice 空气队——is。

questions.q: There ___ many trees near the river.
questions.explain: many trees 复数——are。

questions.q: There ___ a music room in our school.
questions.explain: 一间音乐教室——is。

questions.q: There ___ some juice in the bottle.
questions.explain: juice 空气队——is。

stages.name: 选一选 · 请对报幕员

questions.q: ___ a park near my home.
questions.explain: 「某地有」请报幕员 There is；There has 是缝合怪。

questions.q: My school ___ a big library.
questions.explain: 学校「拥有」图书馆——has。

questions.q: ___ many books in the library.
questions.explain: many books 复数——There are；不能用 have。

questions.q: ___ there a concert tomorrow evening?
questions.explain: a concert 单数——Is there...?

questions.q: ___ there any eggs in the fridge?
questions.explain: eggs 复数——Are there...?

questions.q: There ___ no clouds in the sky today.
questions.explain: clouds 复数——are；There is no + 单数也可以，但这里是复数。

questions.q: I ___ a new flute.
questions.explain: 「我有」是拥有——have。

questions.q: ___ some noise outside. What's that?
questions.explain: noise 不可数——There is。

questions.q: — Is there a music room? — Yes, ___.
questions.explain: 简答重复报幕员：Yes, there is。

questions.q: — Are there any pandas in the zoo? — No, ___.
questions.explain: 复数问复数答：No, there aren't。

questions.q: There ___ a pen and two books in the bag.
questions.explain: 就近原则：先报 a pen——is。

questions.q: There ___ two books and a pen in the bag.
questions.explain: 就近原则：先报 two books——are。

questions.q: There ___ something wrong with my bike.
questions.explain: something 一族当单数——is。

questions.q: How many students ___ in your class?
questions.explain: 特殊疑问句里报幕员倒过来：How many... are there?

questions.q: There ___ a lot of snow in winter here.
questions.explain: snow 空气队——is。a lot of 两队通用。

questions.q: Our band ___ twelve members.
questions.explain: 乐团「拥有」十二名成员——has。

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（桌上的书）
options: There is a book on the desk.
There has a book on the desk.
There have a book on the desk.
questions.explain: 报幕员只带 be——There is。

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（广场上的人）
options: There are many people in the square.
There have many people in the square.
There is many people in the square.
questions.explain: people 复数——There are；have 不能进报幕句。

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（树上的鸟）
options: There is a bird in the tree.
There are a bird in the tree.
There has a bird in the tree.
questions.explain: 一只鸟——is。

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（房间的窗）
options: There are two windows in the room.
There is two windows in the room.
There be two windows in the room.
questions.explain: 两扇窗——are。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（我家附近的公园）
options: There is a park near my home.
It has a park near my home.
Has a park near my home.
questions.explain: 存在句要报幕员开场，不是 it has。

questions.q: — Is there any milk? — ___
questions.explain: 简答重复 there is。

questions.q: 「天上没有云」哪句健康？
options: There aren't any clouds in the sky.
There are no a cloud in the sky.
There isn't any clouds in the sky.
questions.explain: 复数否定 aren't any；no 和 a 不能叠用。

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（碗里的米饭）
options: There is some rice in the bowl.
There are some rice in the bowl.
There have some rice in the bowl.
questions.explain: rice 空气队——is。

questions.q: 「冰箱里有很多牛奶」哪句健康？
options: There is a lot of milk in the fridge.
There is many milk in the fridge.
There are a lot of milk in the fridge.
questions.explain: milk 不可数：is + a lot of / much，不配 many。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（学校的音乐教室）
options: There is a music room in my school.
There is a music room has my school.
My school there is a music room.
questions.explain: 报幕员站句首，地点放句尾。

questions.q: 哪一句的提问是健康的？（动物园的熊猫数量）
options: How many pandas are there in the zoo?
How many pandas there are in the zoo?
How many pandas have there in the zoo?
questions.explain: 疑问句里 are 提到 there 前面。

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（门口有人）
options: There is someone at the door.
There are someone at the door.
There has someone at the door.
questions.explain: someone 当单数——is。

questions.q: 「家里没面包了」哪句健康？
options: There is no bread at home.
There is no a bread at home.
There are no bread at home.
questions.explain: no 直接跟名词；bread 不可数配 is。

questions.q: 哪一句是健康的？（乐团有十二人）
options: There are twelve members in our band.
There have twelve members in our band.
Our band there are twelve members.
questions.explain: 存在句版本：There are... in our band；或者说 Our band has twelve members。

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（果汁提问）
options: Is there any juice in the bottle?
Are there any juice in the bottle?
Has there any juice in the bottle?
questions.explain: juice 不可数——Is there...?

questions.q: 哪一句的报幕是健康的？（湖里的鱼）
options: There are many fish in the lake.
There is many fish in the lake.
There have many fish in the lake.
questions.explain: many fish 复数（fish 复数不变形）——are。

questions.q: 开幕报台：___ a piano, two guitars and a drum on the stage.
questions.explain: 就近原则：先报 a piano——is。

questions.q: 换个顺序报：___ two guitars, a piano and a drum on the stage.
questions.explain: 先报 two guitars——are。

questions.q: I ___ a dog, and ___ a doghouse in our garden.
questions.explain: 「我有狗」用 have；「园里有狗屋」用 There is——两个「有」各回各家。

questions.q: — ___ there a rehearsal today? — No, there ___.
questions.explain: a rehearsal 单数：Is there...? No, there isn't.

questions.q: ___ any homework tonight?（今晚有作业吗）
questions.explain: homework 空气队（联动 G01）——Is there。

questions.q: There ___ a lot of people at the show, and there ___ a lot of noise too.
questions.explain: 报幕员也能报昨天：people 复数 were，noise 不可数 was。

questions.q: ___ thirty days in September.
questions.explain: 说「九月有三十天」用存在句——There are。

questions.q: There ___ nothing in the box. It's empty.
questions.explain: nothing 一族当单数——is。

questions.q: 组合：___ a bank near here? I ___ no money with me.
questions.explain: 问存在 Is there；「我身上没带钱」是拥有——have。

questions.q: How much milk ___ in the fridge?
questions.explain: milk 不可数：How much... is there?

questions.q: ___ a concert next Sunday.（下周日有演出）
questions.explain: 将来也只换 be：There will be，永远轮不到 have。

questions.q: Look! There ___ a little cat and three kittens under the bench.
questions.explain: 就近原则：先报 a little cat——is。

questions.q: There ___ some good news in today's paper.（联动 G01）
questions.explain: news 不可数——is。

questions.q: ___ forty-five students in my class, and every student ___ a dictionary.
questions.explain: 存在 There are；every student 当单数「拥有」——has。

questions.q: — What's in the bottle? — ___ only a little water.
questions.explain: water 不可数——There is；a little 配空气队。

questions.q: 大考：Our music room ___ big. ___ ten violins and a piano in it.
questions.explain: 第一句是等号句（教室=大）用 is；第二句报幕就近看先报的 ten violins——There are。

detective.sentence: There have a piano in the hall.
detective.fixed: There is a piano in the hall.
detective.clue: 两个「有」缝在一起了——报幕员只带 be，不带 have。

detective.sentence: There are a bird singing in the tree.
detective.fixed: There is a bird singing in the tree.
detective.clue: 主角是一只鸟，单数——报幕用 is。

detective.sentence: Has a park near my home.
detective.fixed: There is a park near my home.
detective.clue: 「某地有」要请报幕员 There is 开场，不能用没有主语的 has。

detective.sentence: There is many people in the square.
detective.fixed: There are many people in the square.
detective.clue: people 是复数「人们」——报幕用 are。

detective.sentence: There are some milk in the fridge.
detective.fixed: There is some milk in the fridge.
detective.clue: milk 是空气队（不可数）——报幕用 is。

detective.sentence: There is two windows in my bedroom.
detective.fixed: There are two windows in my bedroom.
detective.clue: 两扇窗，复数——报幕用 are。

detective.fixed: There are forty students in my classroom.
detective.clue: 两处病：教室不「拥有」学生，用存在句更自然；forty 后面要复数 students。
